header.title: How counsellors are scored
header.subtitle: The score is what shows up on every counsellor card and dropdown. Pick a preset, or use Advanced to tune it yourself.

automatic.title: Score them automatically based on performance
automatic.description: The system looks at how many leads they close and how fast, and gives them a score from 0 to 100. Recomputed nightly and after every conversion.

manual.title: I’ll set each counsellor’s score manually
manual.description: No automatic calculation. Use the inputs in Settings → Workbench team to set or update scores by hand.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Closing rate and speed weighted evenly.

closers.label: Reward closers
closers.description: Closing rate matters more than speed.

fast.label: Reward fast callers
fast.description: Speed of close matters more than closing rate.

minSample.label: A counsellor needs at least
minSample.suffix: assigned leads before they get a real score
